 UTICA, NY — A man faces multiple drug charges following a vehicle stop conducted by police investigators.
 Michael Williams, 30, of Utica, was charged Nov. 11, 2026, with various narcotics-related offenses stemming from an ongoing investigation into the sale and distribution of narcotics, according to the Utica Police Department.
 Investigators with the Special Investigations Unit, assisted by patrol units, conducted a vehicle stop during which felony-weight narcotics were found on Williams, police said.
 Williams was transported to the Utica Police Department and charged with criminal possession of a controlled substance in the third degree, criminal sale of a controlled substance in the third degree and criminal possession of a controlled substance in the seventh degree.
